_comment: Curated 'Bag of Hallucinations' (Baranski et al. 2025) — actual outro-phrase hallucinations observed via extension/popup.js click-to-flag labeling, deduped from data/flagged_segments.jsonl on 2026-08-19. Matched by embedding similarity (backend/hallucination_gate.py), not exact string, so morphological variants of the same phrase don't need their own entry. Add a new entry here (not a new regex) when a genuinely new hallucinated phrase family is confirmed via labeling.
